text:
micah_support: FYI Orbitly (trial acct 9876) seeing intermittent embed ingest 502s for 24h. Ticket #12345. Requeue + restart didn't help. Logs: `embed_worker timeout 504 | kv-cache miss spike`. Renewal flagged (~60d). Need CS to lead comms + prioritized runbook.

ashley_cs: Got it. @diego_se to triage, please. We should offer a same-day call.

diego_se: Quick check: kv cache evictions + client burst retries. Mitigation: reduce batch_size -> 8, enable tenant prefix cache. I'll test in staging.

micah_support: Canary deployed at 12:30. Customer reports bad recs; requested 3pm PST call.

emma_onboard_pm: I'll join for runbook. Checklist: gather failing UUIDs, confirm duplicates, prepare reingest window + rollback. Micah paste samples?

micah_support: Samples in ticket: b4f3e2a1, f9c2d7b8. Also seeing token_count spikes.

diego_se: Staging with batch_size=8 + prefix cache => ~90% fewer timeouts. Promoting to canary prod now. If stable, full rollout + reingest in ~2h with read-only fallback.

ashley_cs: Drafted message to customer: "We apologize. We've identified ingestion backpressure causing timeouts and degraded embeddings. We've deployed a mitigation and request a 1hr window to reingest a verified data range. We'll update every 2hrs." Will send after approvals.

nina_sales: I'll join 3pm in case renewal discussion arises.

ops-bot: Canary started tenant=orbitly id=c-1729 at 1743200010 

diego_se: Canary metrics positive: ~95% drop in 502s in first 10m. Monitoring similarity histograms.

ashley_cs: Plan for call: 1) short RCA 2) mitigation steps 3) reingest timeline 4) ask customer for 1hr window and sample verification. Post-call: open eval to validate embeddings and add Orbitly to renewal-watch.

micah_support: Updated ticket with canary KPIs + calendar invite.

ops-bot: Canary promoted to full rollout for tenant=orbitly at 1743200055
